entries.disease_written: EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC
entries.quote: Combination therapy with savolitinib and osimertinib ... has shown activity in patients ... with MET overexpression, MET amplification, or both
entries.cited_text: Combination therapy with savolitinib and osimertinib, an epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR)-TKI, has shown activity in patients with EGFR -mutated, advanced non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) with MET overexpression, MET amplification, or both, after progression during EGFR-TKI therapy. Osimertinib-savolitinib led to significantly longer progression-free survival than platinum-pemetrexed (hazard ratio for disease progression or death, 0.55; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.42 to 0.72; P EGFR -mutated, locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC with MET overexpression, MET amplification, or both that had progressed during osimertinib therapy (Funded by AstraZeneca; SAFFRON ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT05261399.).

checker.reason: The SAFFRON trial (randomised) demonstrates that MET overexpression/amplification predicts improved PFS with osimertinib plus savolitinib compared to chemotherapy in EGFR-mutated NSCLC.
